items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Well, he was a good friend of ours, you know.

ctx.x: I'm wondering about some more of the trombonists when you were young. Did you ever hear Roy Palmer? Do you remember Roy Palmer? No, I don't remember Roy Palmer. Played in the district a little. Who were some of the trombonists when you first started playing that you heard?

I heard, uh, this fella, a young fella, yeah, he was, oh, I can't think of that boy's name. He left, yeah, Zoo Robinson. I was gonna ask you, just start asking, yeah, Zoo Robinson. Zoo Robinson. Well, he was a good friend of ours, you know. He was a good musician. Mm-hmm. Zoo Robinson. Well, I heard this other boy, this boy.
